text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, labetalol hydrochloride 100 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 301 tablets with 11.4 tablets used daily, providing 26.3 days on hand. Corvale General holds 297 tablets with 13.8 tablets used daily, providing 21.6 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): The product label for NDC 23155072305 identifies Heritage Pharma Labs Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Labs Inc. (FEI 3005139373) as the registered manufacturing plant. FDA inspection records for that plant show multiple Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classifications from 2009 through 2018, with the most recent inspection ending 2018-02-06 and a known date of 2018-05-07. The most recent inspection listed for the plant is a No Action Indicated (NAI) inspection dated 2023-09-19.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately three weeks of supply at both sites. No national shortage is declared. Alternate manufacturers are available but their labels do not identify a verifiable plant location.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies current supply status and lead times with Advagen Pharma Ltd., Biocon Pharma Inc., and BluePoint Laboratories; buyer approves purchase orders.
2. Buyer confirms plant registration details for any alternate source before committing inventory; buyer approves vendor qualification.
3. Pharmacy director reviews inventory thresholds and authorizes safety stock adjustments; pharmacy director approves.
4. P&T committee acknowledges supply monitoring plan; committee chair approves.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
